editorial:
Imagine your favorite horror tropes getting tossed into a blender and set to high speed. You get to follow the Core Four, who are now much older and just trying to live their lives until that same creepy masked killer comes back for round two. The vibe is totally chaotic and doesn't take itself seriously for even a second. It feels like a big party where every single scene is making fun of a different scary movie you have seen a million times. You will find yourself laughing at the ridiculous situations and the way the characters react to things that would normally be terrifying.

The acting is surprisingly great because the cast knows exactly how to play the jokes for big laughs. While some of the gags might feel a bit random, the fast pace keeps you from getting bored. If you love movies that roast pop culture, you need to see this.
endingExplained: In the final act, you find out the killer is actually a failed movie director who wanted to make the most realistic horror film ever. He tries to trap the group in a giant movie set, but the Core Four use their knowledge of movie clichés to trick him. They lure him into a giant prop trap that crushes him. The movie ends with the group laughing as they realize they are now the stars of their own hit movie.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves making fun of horror movies and likes loud, silly humor.
